name: smoke-reentry-d3d12
description: E1L1 smoke remains behind the camera for 300 tics before an exact 180-degree turn and bounded reacquisition dwell.
limitations: The compact window characterizes the settled returned view; first-frame reacquisition remains an image/short-trace checkpoint.
commands: +wait 45; load smoke-offscreen; wait 35; closemenu; wait 1; centerview; wait 299; nri_ptsmokestatus; perf_compactframes 192; turnaround; wait 35; nri_ptsmokestatus
